entities.name: Vibranium
entities.description: Indestructible metal that absorbs, stores and releases kinetic energy, associated with Wakanda; used in the Black Panther's suit.

entities.name: Black Panther
entities.description: User whose suit is made of vibranium.

entities.name: Captain America
